turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm a student and I have like forty dollars until the end of the month. Help.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, we can work with that. How many days until you get money again?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a bit over three dollars a day. Focus on cheap staples like rice, beans, eggs, oats and bananas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was going to go out with friends on Friday

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You could suggest something free instead, like a movie night at someone's place where everyone brings a snack.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a second, that could work. Does my campus have anything that helps?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Many campuses have a food pantry for students, no questions asked. It's worth checking your student services page.
